title: Enterprise AI Advisory Services
description: We provide focused advice on AI strategy, architecture, security and cloud readiness. Our work helps organisations evaluate options and plan implementation with greater clarity.

services.title: AI Strategy & Roadmap
services.cardDescription: Identify where AI creates value and plan its adoption.
services.description: Determine where AI is useful and what it will take to introduce it.
services.whatWeDo: Assess business opportunities, technical feasibility, existing capabilities and investment priorities.
services.whatYouReceive: A prioritised set of AI opportunities, recommendations and an implementation roadmap.

services.title: AI Architecture & Integration
services.cardDescription: Design AI solutions that work with existing enterprise systems.
services.description: Plan how AI will work within your existing technology environment.
services.whatWeDo: Evaluate application architecture, data access, integration patterns and solution options.
services.whatYouReceive: Architecture recommendations, key design decisions and integration guidance.

services.title: AI Security & Governance
services.cardDescription: Assess risks and define appropriate security controls.
services.description: Understand and address the risks of enterprise AI adoption.
services.whatWeDo: Review identity, data protection, access controls, cloud security and governance requirements.
services.whatYouReceive: A security and governance assessment with prioritised recommendations.

services.title: AI Agents & Intelligent Automation
services.cardDescription: Evaluate opportunities to automate business workflows.
services.description: Assess where AI agents and automation can support business workflows.
services.whatWeDo: Evaluate candidate processes, integration needs, human oversight and operational risks.
services.whatYouReceive: Use-case recommendations, solution options and a practical validation approach.

services.title: AI Cloud Readiness & Scalability
services.cardDescription: Prepare AWS and Azure environments for AI workloads.
services.description: Prepare your cloud architecture for AI workloads.
services.whatWeDo: Assess AWS or Azure infrastructure, scalability, reliability, monitoring and cost considerations.
services.whatYouReceive: A cloud readiness review and recommended architecture improvements.

services.title: AI Implementation & Value Realisation
services.cardDescription: Turn agreed AI opportunities into working solutions, with clear success measures and operational readiness.
services.description: This service is an optional follow-on to our advisory engagements, supporting clients who need help implementing the recommendations.
services.whatWeDo: Implement agreed AI solutions, integrate them with enterprise systems and prepare them for operation.
services.whatYouReceive: An implemented solution within the agreed scope, deployment documentation and validation against defined success criteria.

blueprint.title: Enterprise AI Transformation Blueprint
blueprint.description: A focused assessment combining AI opportunity evaluation, architecture, security and a phased implementation roadmap.
